data.spec: User asks for severity agent call and confirmation decision plus WhatsApp or dashboard critical alerts. Add optional Interpretation.assessment={severity:'routine'|'urgent'|'critical',confidence:0..1,requires_confirmation:boolean,reason:string}; Pydantic AI fills it in same bounded structured call. Server enforces require_approval global OR assessment critical/low-confidence/requires_confirmation OR service_requires_approval; model may escalate but cannot override hard limits. Sensor rule can set minimum severity. Persist request.assessment and request.approval_required. Dashboard alerts are authoritative API projection GET /api/alerts -> {id,request_id,severity,title,detail,created_at,acknowledged_at}[], POST /api/alerts/:id/acknowledge {}; existing requests.updated SSE signals refresh. No real WhatsApp send enabled. Dashboard owner may render alerts and optional sourcing without this task editing App.tsx.
